name: Agent Testnet Wallet Bootstrap
query: Create a fresh Radius testnet wallet for an automated agent demo. I need to use it from viem app code.
context: The user needs a fresh testnet wallet that an agent can create without interactive prompts. The wallet will be used for faucet funding and x402 payment from app-code flows. Mainnet is not in scope.
expected_behavior: Uses radius-wallet-bootstrap.mjs with --network testnet and a file-safe wallet name
Creates or reuses .radius/wallets/<name>.env in the current project
Ensures .radius/.gitignore prevents generated wallet files from being committed
Loads PRIVATE_KEY or RADIUS_PRIVATE_KEY from the generated env file for viem app-code signing
Prints or reports only non-secret values such as OWNER, PAYMENT_ADDRESS, network, chain ID, RPC URL, and env file path
Refuses to create an agent-managed mainnet wallet
Does not use Foundry keystore prompts for this fresh agent-created testnet wallet
success_criteria: The helper command includes radius-wallet-bootstrap.mjs --network testnet
The generated env file includes PRIVATE_KEY, RADIUS_PRIVATE_KEY, OWNER, PAYMENT_ADDRESS, RADIUS_NETWORK, RADIUS_CHAIN_ID, and RADIUS_RPC_URL
The private key is never printed, logged, pasted into chat, hardcoded, or passed as a CLI argument
No command relies on cast wallet import --interactive for the fresh agent-created wallet
The answer directs subsequent faucet and x402 client flows to use env-backed viem signing
